name: europe-news-digest
description: European news digest from major outlets across Western, Central, and Eastern Europe

steps.name: fetch-uk-ireland
steps.prompt:
Fetch UK and Ireland news:

🇬🇧 UK Sources:
- BBC News: https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/rss.xml
- The Guardian: https://feeds.theguardian.com/theguardian/rss
- Reuters UK: https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/UKdomesticNews

🇮🇪 Ireland:
- Irish Times: https://www.irishtimes.com/rss/top-stories.xml

Extract top 3-5 recent stories per source with headline and brief summary.

steps.name: fetch-western-europe
steps.prompt:
Fetch Western European news:

🇩🇪 Germany:
- Deutsche Welle: https://rss.dw.com/rdf/rss-en-all
- The Local Germany: https://www.thelocal.de/feeds/rss.xml

🇫🇷 France:
- France 24: https://www.france24.com/en/rss
- The Local France: https://www.thelocal.fr/feeds/rss.xml

🇳🇱 Netherlands:
- DutchNews.nl: https://dutchnews.nl/feed/

🇧🇪 Belgium:
- Brussels Times: https://www.brusselstimes.com/feed/

🇪🇸 Spain:
- El Pais English: https://english.elpais.com/rss feeds (check available)
- The Local Spain: https://www.thelocal.es/feeds/rss.xml

🇮🇹 Italy:
- The Local Italy: https://www.thelocal.it/feeds/rss.xml

Extract top 3 recent stories per country. Return structured list with country flags.

steps.name: fetch-nordics
steps.prompt:
Fetch Nordic region news:

🇳🇴 Norway:
- The Local Norway: https://www.thelocal.no/feeds/rss.xml
- NRK (check if English feed available, otherwise note)

🇸🇪 Sweden:
- The Local Sweden: https://www.thelocal.se/feeds/rss.xml

🇫🇮 Finland:
- Yle News: https://feeds.yle.fi/uutiset/v1/majorHeadlines/YLE_UUTISET.rss
- News Now Finland: https://newsnowfinland.com/feed/

🇩🇰 Denmark:
- The Local Denmark: https://www.thelocal.dk/feeds/rss.xml

🇮🇸 Iceland:
- Iceland Review: https://icelandreview.com/feed/

Extract top 2-3 recent stories per Nordic country. Return structured list.

steps.name: fetch-eastern-europe
steps.prompt:
Fetch Eastern/Central European news:

🇵🇱 Poland:
- Warsaw Business Journal: https://www.wbj.pl/rss.xml (if available)
- Notes from Poland: https://notesfrompoland.com/feed/

🇺🇦 Ukraine:
- Kyiv Independent: https://kyivindependent.com/feed/

🇷🇺 Russia (Western perspective):
- Moscow Times: https://www.themoscowtimes.com/rss/news

Extract top 2-3 recent stories per source. Focus on significant developments. Return structured list.

steps.name: format-europe-digest
steps.prompt:
Create a comprehensive Europe news digest for Discord.

**UK & IRELAND:**
{{uk_ireland}}

**WESTERN EUROPE:**
{{western_europe}}

**NORDICS:**
{{nordics}}

**EASTERN EUROPE:**
{{eastern_europe}}

FORMAT:
```
🇪🇺 **Europe News Digest — {date}**

**🇬🇧 United Kingdom & 🇮🇪 Ireland**
• [Headline] — Summary (Source)
• [Headline] — Summary

**🇩🇪 Germany, 🇫🇷 France, 🇳🇱 Netherlands, 🇧🇪 Belgium**
• [Headline] — Summary (Country flag)
• [Headline] — Summary

**🇪🇸 Spain & 🇮🇹 Italy**
• [Headline] — Summary
• [Headline] — Summary

**🇳🇴 Norway, 🇸🇪 Sweden, 🇫🇮 Finland, 🇩🇰 Denmark, 🇮🇸 Iceland**
• [Headline] — Summary (Nordic context)
• [Headline] — Summary

**🇵🇱 Poland, 🇺🇦 Ukraine, Eastern Europe**
• [Headline] — Summary
• [Headline] — Summary

_Covering 15+ European nations — OpenFang Europe_
```

Select the most significant pan-European stories. Keep under 2000 characters.
